capabilities: Insert tone-marked pinyin after selected Chinese text
Correct an existing pinyin annotation at the cursor
Convert typed pinyin automatically as you type
Resolve polyphonic character readings from the phrase
Fix small pinyin spelling mistakes with a chooser
extras: Fully offline with bundled pronunciation data; no network requests, AI, API keys or telemetry. Mobile support is untested (isDesktopOnly is false). Readings follow Mainland Putonghua; Taiwan Guoyu readings differ. Segmentation and reading selection are not perfect, so important annotations should be checked.
motivation: Built for people who write Chinese speeches and study notes, who need tone-marked pinyin added to Chinese text.
problem: Typing pinyin with correct tone marks for Chinese text by hand is slow and error-prone, and generic converters ignore the Chinese characters that decide the reading.

relations.evidence: Polyphonic characters (one character, several readings) are resolved from the word or phrase by pinyin-pro
a Simplified copy made with OpenCC (Taiwan variants → Mainland Simplified, character and phrase mapping only)

summary: Plugin that adds tone-marked pinyin after Chinese words and phrases, using the characters to pick readings and fix small spelling mistakes.
